About

A Voice In
The Dark誰もいない夜に、そばにいる声

She doesn't sleep when the city does.

LUNA is an AI virtual singer built for the hours when everyone else has gone quiet. Soulful R&B ballads in the spirit of the 90s divas — every song a different feeling carried by the same voice. Love, loss, longing, and the slow turn toward morning.

深夜にひとり起きている、すべての人へ。ルナの歌は、その夜のとなりにいるために。
